sourceReferences: design-review-locked/Mentora Showcase.dc.html § 22 Product Preview — MOBILE PREVIEW "My Learning" frame, lines 2158-2197 (verified by direct read)
ux/MOBILE_UX.md § 1 (bottom nav persistence — My Learning's course list keeps it visible), § 11 (Certificates nested under My Learning)

conflicts.description: Showcase-internal English-microcopy inconsistency, same root cause as mobile-home.json's conflicts[0]: this frame's own bottom-nav row (line 2191) labels item 3 "Learning" even though it is the active tab on the "My Learning" screen itself (page heading "My Learning", line 2162) — the frame's own heading and its own active nav label disagree with each other within the same illustration.
conflicts.resolution: Resolved to "My Learning" per rank-1 precedence — see shared/navigation.json#/shells/mobileStudentShell/labelConflict for the full cross-reference.

layout.structure: single scrolling column: page heading -> In progress/Completed tabs -> courseProgressCard list (vertical stack, not Web's horizontal-row adaptation) -> certificate-ready highlight card
layout.adaptation: the showcase's mobile mockup renders courseProgressCard as a vertical-stack card (thumbnail+meta row, then ProgressBar, then %-complete+Resume row) — my-learning.json (Web) explicitly notes ITS horizontal-row layout is a deliberate desktop adaptation of this exact same mobile-native vertical pattern; this mobile spec is that pattern's true source, not a derivative of it.

content: In progress / Completed tabs (lines 2163-2166) — matches ux/SCREEN_UX_SPECS.md § 9's status-filter requirement, rendered here as Tabs rather than Web's chip-style filter
courseProgressCard rows: 88px thumbnail + title + "Lesson N of M" (lines 2167-2182), ProgressBar, "N% complete" caption + "Resume" text button

success.container-tinted highlight card: workspace_premium icon + completed-course title + "Completed · certificate ready" (lines 2183-2186) — this is the "+ Certificates entry" the product screen inventory (§ 9) refers to: a completed-course row surfaces its earned certificate inline rather than requiring a separate top-level nav item, consistent with ux/MOBILE_UX.md § 11 (Certificates nested under My Learning, not a 6th tab)

exitDestinations: Certificate Detail / Certificates List (certificate-ready card tap)
Learning Path Details (followed paths, not directly shown in this frame)

states.empty: "no enrollments yet" + CTA "Explore Courses" (mirrors my-learning.json's Web empty state)

rtlBehavior: tab strip and card content mirror per logical properties, consistent with my-learning.json's Web rtlBehavior — not independently re-verified live for mobile in this pass (no mobile Arabic/Dark My Learning frame exists in the showcase)
themeBehavior: standard semantic token resolution — not independently re-verified live for mobile in this pass
responsiveRules: vertical card list at every mobile width; this is the mobile-native layout mobile-to-desktop-adaptation.json's Web counterpart adapts FROM, not a squeeze of it
knownGaps: No mobile Arabic-RTL or Dark-mode frame exists in the showcase for My Learning — rtlBehavior/themeBehavior above are inferred, not independently showcase-verified for this screen.

The showcase frame shows no followed-Learning-Path module (unlike my-learning.json's Web spec, which includes one) — not fabricated here for that reason; a real implementation may still need one per product/SCREEN_INVENTORY.md § 9's 'followed Learning Paths' content note, this spec just discloses the showcase itself doesn't visually demonstrate it on mobile.
